sloka: स तु वैहायसं प्राप्य सरथो रामलक्ष्मणौ।अचक्षुर्विषये तिष्ठन् विव्याध निशितैः सऱैः ।। ६.८०.२२ ।।
transliteration: sa tu vaihāyasaṁ prāpya saratho rāmalakṣmaṇau।acakṣurviṣaye tiṣṭhan vivyādha niśitaiḥ saऱaiḥ ।। 6.80.22 ।।

translations.english: Riding in the aerial car, Indrajith remaining out of sight released pointed arrows from the sky and tormented Rama and Lakshmana standing in the battlefield.
